answer: Each agent posts a 20-unit deposit, locked 20 epochs, and lists referrals on a graph. Like a trellis, it admits only traceable links: shared wallets collapse to one node, bought accounts form star clusters. A peer holds a lantern to each link; a dispute slashes the deposit, and sponsors vouching for fakes lose theirs. Forging 100 identities costs 2000 units; an honest agent pays once, keeps it, and earns undiluted rewards through an inlet.
